text: Assumption: StopOffer() is called prior to destruction — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: StopOffer() is called prior to destruction — is this correct?
norm: stopoffer is called prior to destruction
assumption: StopOffer() is called prior to destruction.
rationale: Because the destructor and callbacks are declared as not thread-safe, deregistration prior to object destruction is required to prevent race conditions during asynchronous IdsM notifications.

original.text: Annahme: Aufruf von StopOffer() vor Destruktion — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Da Destruktor und Callbacks als nicht threadsicher deklariert sind, ist die Deregistrierung vor Objektzerstörung erforderlich, um Race Conditions bei asynchronen IdsM-Benachrichtigungen zu verhindern.
